System Design attempt edits strictly parse one complete canonical runtime worksheet and its loaded integer revision before account work, then accept only an exact correlated one-row result whose revision advances by one; errors, malformed results, and stale zero-row conflicts preserve the current revision and cannot claim a save. Executable parser, result, and pending-edit display-state matrices plus source-integration checks cover draft-preserving manual-submit wiring, synchronous duplicate protection, exact-snapshot truth, atomic live-region semantics, focus-preserving pending/conflict controls, and the conflict-only safe same-attempt recovery link in npm run test:system-design-workspace; rendered draft retention, conflict recovery, focus, and assistive-technology behavior remain browser/manual validation.

Full System Design item-progress edits strictly parse one canonical item/type, complete rich-field snapshot, explicit bookmark presence, and an absent sentinel or persisted revision before account work. Save and delete share an owner/attempt lock, so a concurrent save-versus-delete race has one winner while stale, problem-mismatched, foreign, missing, malformed, and failed deletes preserve the worksheet. After an authenticated actor is resolved, admin membership false remains an indistinguishable not-found response, while membership-query failures and failed or malformed dashboard-count, feedback-list, and feedback-detail results surface the sanitized retryable application error before zero, honest-empty, or not-found rendering. Executable resolver matrices and source-integration checks run in npm run test:feedback-admin-operations; shared actor failures fail closed before the admin membership query.

Feedback triage strictly parses the complete status-and-private-note snapshot before admin capability work, binds it to the detail page's exact revision, and accepts only one correlated RPC result.
